content:
iOS 27 will be released to all users next week, followed shortly by the first iOS 27.1 beta and then the final version. Here is the expected timeline for iOS 27.1.

iOS 27.1 will arrive in October ahead of the iPhone Duo launch, with the beta expected in about a week.

If you're not already enrolled in Apple's beta program, a major iPhone software update arrives next week.

iOS 27 officially launches this Monday, September 14, with new features including Siri AI.

However, if you've been testing iOS 27 betas all summer, you should now be looking ahead to iOS 27.1.

Apple is expected to release the first iOS 27.1 beta roughly one week after iOS 27 ships. Here's a look at recent timing:

  • iOS 26.1 beta dropped 7 days after iOS 26
  • iOS 17.1 beta dropped 9 days after iOS 17
  • iOS 16.1 beta dropped 2 days after iOS 16

I left iOS 18 out because Apple released its 18.1 beta earlier this summer as a way to test Apple Intelligence.

Following the usual pattern, iOS 27.1 beta 1 could arrive as early as next week or as late as the week of September 21.

What about the final version?

Apple confirmed this week that iOS 27.1 will launch on or before October 23, with a chance it arrives a few days earlier.

Its iPhone Duo press release noted: "iPhone Duo will ship with iOS 27.1." Since iPhone Duo reaches users on October 23, the software update must drop before that date.

This timing is actually a bit earlier than usual. Counting back from 2025, the past four years saw Apple's x.1 updates land on November 3, October 28, October 25, and October 24, respectively.

Given that iOS 27.1 will launch alongside iPhone Duo, the most likely window for the final release is Monday, October 19 through Wednesday, October 21.

Beyond iPhone Duo-exclusive features, what else this update will include remains unknown. We'll keep you posted once the first beta drops.
